markets.rules_primary: If the U.S. Supreme Court issues an order permitting Missouri's HB 1 congressional map to govern the November 3, 2026 general election in any U.S. Supreme Court proceeding arising from People Not Politicians and Richard von Glahn v. Denny Hoskins, Missouri Supreme Court No. SC101805 before Nov 3, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The ruling must:
Be issued by the U.S. Supreme Court in any U.S. Supreme Court proceeding arising from People Not Politicians and Richard von Glahn v. Denny Hoskins, Missouri Supreme Court No. SC101805
Address the matter described by the specified judgment
Be issued through a written order, opinion, judgment, or decision

The following do NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion:
Oral rulings from the bench unless reduced to a written order
Tentative rulings that are not made final
Draft opinions that leak but are not officially issued
Settlements or voluntary dismissals
Administrative or scheduling orders
Orders to show cause
Minute orders that do not address the substantive issue in the specified judgment

For clarity:
If the case is dismissed for lack of jurisdiction, that counts as a ruling only if the judgment refers to jurisdiction
Sua sponte rulings count if they match the specified judgment
Per curiam opinions and summary orders count as rulings
If multiple judges issue separate opinions, the majority/plurality opinion controls

markets.rules_primary: If David Kustoff is the person in Congress that has the highest return on their assets in 2025, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: The Underlying for this Contract is the identity of the member of Congress with the greatest percent difference in the value of their assets in their end of year report for 2025 compared to the previous year (2025 value minus the previous year's value, all divided by the previous year's value, times one hundred). This will be calculated using Congress' annual personal financial disclosures (OGE Form 278e). Because each asset is given as a range of values in the disclosures, we use the midpoint of each range as an estimated value for that asset. The midpoint is calculated by taking the lower bound of the reported range plus the upper bound, and dividing by two. For example, if an asset is reported in the $15,001 – $50,000 range, the midpoint used would be $32,500.5 (the average of 15,001 and 50,000). In cases where the disclosure uses an open-ended top category (for instance, some forms list "Over $50,000,000" as the highest category for an asset value, with no upper limit), we will assign a value of $50,000,001 for that asset.
markets.title: Which member of Congress will have the biggest returns this year?

markets.rules_primary: If exactly 0 governors lose re-election in 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: Members count as losing re-election if they actively seek re-election (by filing candidacy or appearing on ballot) but fail to win. This includes losses in primaries, general elections, runoffs, retention elections, or recalls. Members who retire, withdraw before primaries, die, resign, or are disqualified do not count as losses. If redistricting forces two group members against each other, the loser counts. Members who switch parties after issuance remain part of the original group. If a member loses their party primary but wins as an independent, they did not lose re-election.

markets.rules_primary: If the FDA's decision on Bepirovirsen by GlaxoSmithKline in 2026 is a full approval or an accelerated approval, the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This market will resolve to No if the FDA's decision is a denial (CRL issued), a withdrawal by the sponsor, or a conditional approval — or if no decision is issued. 

Bepirovirsen is an experimental antiviral medicine developed by GlaxoSmithKline that is designed to clear the hepatitis B virus from the body rather than just keeping it asleep. It belongs to a modern class of gene-silencing therapies that hunt down and destroy the virus's replication instructions. This is similar to intercepting and shredding a virus’s blueprints before its cell-invading factory has a chance to read them and build new viral copies.
markets.title: What will the FDA's decision be on Bepirovirsen by GlaxoSmithKline in 2026?
